reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The metric is exposed under the new name `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt` instead of `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt`, so anything that reads the old name has to be updated.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries that use `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`.
